title: platostoma stoloniferum
intro: Platostoma stoloniferum, commonly known as Java tea or Java mint, is a species of flowering plant in the mint family, Lamiaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include providing relief from digestive issues, fever, and other health problems. The therapeutic actions of Platostoma stoloniferum are attributed to its antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic properties, which help to soothe and calm the body. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal effects.
